transcript.text: LG FWV917BTSE keeps stopping with tE on the screen during the 60 wash. Turned it off and on, worked once, now it's back. Whats wrong with it?

The 'tE' code on LG washer-dryers typically indicates a temperature sensor error or a heating fault. Since it happens during a 60°C cycle, the machine is likely failing to detect the water reaching the correct temperature. To narrow this down: when the tE code appears and stops the wash, is the water inside the drum hot or cold? If you can safely check (without touching live parts), touch the door glass or put your hand in the water. If it's ice-cold during a heated cycle, it points to either the heating element not working or the temperature sensor giving a false reading.
The door glass stays cold during a 40 or 60 wash. No burning smell or trips, nothing unusual.

[Heading: Faulty NTC temperature sensor (thermistor)]
The 'tE' code on LG washer-dryers indicates a heating or water-temperature error. Since the door glass stays cold during heated cycles, the machine is not generating heat. This usually points to one of two things: either the wash heating element has failed (so no heat is produced), or more commonly, the NTC temperature sensor (thermistor) is faulty and giving a false reading that prevents the heater from turning on. Given that the error appeared once after a restart but returned immediately, it suggests an intermittent electrical fault. The most likely culprit is the NTC temperature sensor itself, as these can fail intermittently before dying completely. A failed heating element would also cause this, but the sensor is often the primary suspect when the machine refuses to heat at all. To fix this, you will need a qualified engineer to replace the faulty component (likely the NTC sensor or the heating element). These parts require dismantling the appliance and testing with multimeters. Please do not attempt to open the casing yourself as there is a risk of electric shock. Contact an LG authorised service provider or a local appliance repair engineer.
